title: System mode by default, says Dex
myth: Apex database operations always run in system mode by default.

beats.say: Dex swears Apex runs in system mode by default.
beats.speaker: dex

beats.say: Archie draws one word: depends. On the API version.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: From version sixty-seven, database operations run in user mode by default.
So the user's permissions, field security and sharing apply.
Older code keeps system mode. Dex checks his version numbers.

facts.claim: From Apex API version 67.0, Apex database operations run in user mode by default.
facts.evidence: From version 67.0, Apex database operations run in user mode by default

facts.claim: Code saved at API version 66.0 or earlier keeps system mode as the default.
facts.evidence: Code saved at 66.0 or earlier keeps system mode as the default

facts.claim: User mode applies the running user's object permissions, field-level security and record sharing.
facts.evidence: applies the running user's object permissions, field-level security
